desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original high-end Room & Ritual secondary website page, image-only. Image 1 is the approved BRAND/PHOTOGRAPHIC IDENTITY reference, not a layout template. Brand identity: Exact compact mixed-case 'Room & Ritual' with a restrained same-font ampersand. Olive curved sofa, orange mushroom lamp, walnut, black-framed arches, sunlit courtyard. Do not clone the homepage layout.
Typography: Fraunces 500/600 for compact mixed-case wordmark and expressive headlines; Manrope 400/500 for navigation and body.
Palette: Light golden apricot #F7DFB9 and lighter golden #FCF0DA, subtle golden #F2D39D with dark warm brown #5B3523. Visibly warm golden, not pink or beige/taupe. Selective warm off-white is okay.
Clean grid and air are critical: no decorative boxes/cards, no repeated alternating bands. Align all photographs and captions to purposeful grid edges. Natural photo geometry. No invented factual claims, testimonials, locations, times or specifications. Fewer elements, elegantly composed, crisp readable text. No browser/device/presentation frame.
FORMAT: complete DESKTOP website from header to footer, tall portrait width:height 2:3, native target1536x2304. It represents1440logicalpx-wide desktop, real multi-column layout. 96logicalpx side margins; all content/photo edges share the main grid. 120–180logicalpx vertical pauses between chapters, 32px between images and captions/links. DO NOT pack to fill; open colored ground is welcome. Highest native clarity.
HEADER: Small Room & Ritual left. Projects (selected for first two pages), Studio, Start a project right. No huge homepage masthead.
PAGE: An airy curated interior project catalogue. Start with compact header, then title 'Rooms for living.' and short line 'A selection of homes and everyday places.' Generous empty golden ground. First project: a wide landscaped photo of a new-angle Courtyard House living room looking outward through black-framed arch, olive curved sofa and orange lamp; below caption '01 — The Courtyard House', 'Open to light, built for living.' and 'Explore the house ↗'. After a large pause, a two-column aligned row with unequal image widths (same upper baseline): a wide leafy outdoor timber table caption '02 — Olive Terrace' / 'Gathering, outdoors.' and smaller tall wood-and-linen bedroom caption '03 — Cedar Rooms' / 'A quieter place to rest.' Do not mix captions. Align captions with photo left edges. Then a concise invitation 'What would home feel like?' with 'Start a project →', and complete footer. Exactly three project photos, no more promotional panels.
FOOTER: Room & Ritual. Home · Projects · Studio · Start a project. Privacy · Terms. Compact and spacious, fully visible.
